name: document_uncentered_f2c_matched_manus_grab_transfer_v1
manus: Frozen MANUS Session 1 source, Session 2 validation and Session 3 descriptive final; six users, 8 channels, 200 Hz, external source-only Rest prior. The parent native trial IDs, source-only fit_predict rule and class order remain fixed.
grab: Frozen GRABMyo Day1 users 1-4 source, 5-6 validation, 7-8 descriptive final; native 8 channels at 2048 Hz, official file hashes and exact parent 20-window aggregation. Source-only StandardScaler/LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260924.
decision: Compare matched validation F1 and log loss with F0v2 and previously screened centered F2c. Final is descriptive. Apply the existing three-axis public default guard only after the separate wearing arm and both transfer axes are saved.
boundary: The public source recordings have been inspected before. This candidate test is not a new independent cohort or the user's own-device 250 Hz validation.
